title: Auto Kick BEST OUT RN
script:
repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local function Kick()
    local args = {"kick"}
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("BallEvent"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

local function Perfect()
    local args = {"getAccuracy", 1}
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("BallEvent"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

local AutoKick = false
local AutoKickMode = "Legit"

local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait() do
        if AutoKick and AutoKickMode then
            if AutoKickMode == "Blatant" then
                Kick()
                task.wait(0.15)
            elseif AutoKickMode == "Legit" then
                Perfect()
                task.wait(0.15)
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.H, false, game)
                VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.H, false, game)
            end
        end
    end
end)
